The official CSV assets are now stored under `data/raw/`.

Official source:

- Dataset: OPSSAT-AD — anomaly detection dataset for satellite telemetry
- DOI: `10.5281/zenodo.12588358`
- Zenodo data record: `https://zenodo.org/records/12588359`
- Official code repository: `https://github.com/kplabs-pl/OPS-SAT-AD`
